text.name: Tariff Shock
text.rules: Record "tariff wall". Draw from the Contingency deck of the side that played this card. If the result is 3 or more, until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1. SAE chooses: Retaliate? If yes, SAE spends 1 point on actions, then until the end of this turn, each time SAE spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1; if no, at the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point placing influence.
text.history: On 2 April 2025 the U.S. President announced a 10 per cent tariff on imports from almost all countries, effective 5 April, with higher rates for many trading partners announced for 9 April; the rates changed repeatedly in the following months.
